NDT software in Toledo, Ohio: two refineries, a nuclear plant and a manufacturing base

Toledo punches above its size as an inspection market. Two refineries sit on the city's east side: the Cenovus Toledo refinery in Oregon, which Cenovus took full ownership of in 2023, and PBF Energy's Toledo refinery. Both run regular turnarounds and planned maintenance that pull in NDT crews. Along the lake shore east of the city, the Davis-Besse nuclear plant near Oak Harbor brings outage work with strict qualification expectations. Stellantis builds Jeeps at the Toledo Assembly Complex, the city's long glass-making history continues in manufacturing and research, and the Port of Toledo handles bulk cargo, grain and liquid terminals. Pipelines and tank farms tie the refineries to the wider Midwest, and Cenovus also operates the Lima refinery an hour and a half south.

The typical Toledo NDT contractor is a small to mid-sized firm, often family-run or founded by a Level III, with a core team of experienced technicians who cover northwest Ohio, southeast Michigan and northeast Indiana. They may run a small in-house training programme to grow their own Level Is and IIs, and they compete against larger regional firms on responsiveness and paperwork quality. For a company that size, the office work of certifications, calibration, reports and billing often falls on the same two or three people. The Atlantis ERP solution is built to take that load off. It is affordable, accessible and fully customizable, and pricing is quote on request.

ERP for NDT companies in Toledo: the direct answer

An ERP for NDT companies in Toledo should let a small team run refinery, nuclear and manufacturing work with the same discipline a large contractor has, without adding office staff. The Atlantis ERP puts certifications, procedures, instruments, dispatch, reports, quoting and invoicing in one system, so the data is entered once and reused.

Most small NDT companies grow into a patchwork: a certification spreadsheet, a calibration calendar, Word report forms, and accounting software that knows nothing about methods or technicians. Each works on its own, but nothing connects, so every client audit becomes a document hunt. The Atlantis ERP links the report to the technician's certification, the procedure revision and the instrument's calibration automatically. The full list of modules is on the ERP apps page.

NDT software for small NDT companies in Toledo

Small NDT companies need software that is simple to start with, does not assume a large IT department, and grows with the business. The Atlantis ERP can go live with a few core apps, typically certificates, instruments and reporting, and add quoting, invoicing, CRM and dashboards as the company is ready.

For a Toledo firm with a dozen technicians, that might mean month one is getting every certificate, vision test and instrument into the system and turning on expiry alerts, month two is moving reports to the offline field app, and later phases bring in quoting and invoicing. Because Atlantis NDT sets up and supports the system, you are not left configuring it yourself. The founder, Anoop Rayavarapu, is an ASNT NDT Level III, so the conversation starts with how your written practice works, not with software jargon.

The Dashboards app gives the owner a view of NDT KPIs such as equipment calibration due or overdue, certificates expiring or expired and issued equipment overdue for return, alongside a financial dashboard. For a small business that is often the first time all of those numbers have been on one screen.

Technician certification tracking software and in-house qualification

Technician certification tracking in the Atlantis ERP records each certificate with scheme, level, method, certifying body and dates, and computes status automatically as active, expiring soon within 90 days, expired or revoked. It also records the training and exam evidence behind each certification.

That last part is useful for Toledo firms that qualify their own people. The Certificates app records OJT hours, training hours and whether the exam was passed. Examination sheets capture general, specific and practical scores against a passing score that defaults to 70 percent, with the exam files attached. Certificate templates per scheme hold validity in months, whether a vision test or exam is required, and minimum OJT and training hours, so the system reflects what your written practice says. Vision tests record near vision (Jaeger J1 or J2), far vision, colour perception, contrast, examiner, clinic and expiry.

Schemes supported include SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP and other. Daily checks create warning tasks 90 days before a certificate or vision test expires, email alerts go to the people you choose, and timesheets warn when a technician's certificate is not valid. Nuclear outage clients such as Davis-Besse expect that level of control, and having it in one place makes pre-job submittals much faster.

Training your own technicians with eLearning and 3D practice

Atlantis offers ASNT SNT-TC-1A-based NDT training, and the ERP's eLearning app gives you a course portal with Level I, II and III sections for your own technicians.

Video lessons can be hosted from OneDrive or SharePoint with download protection. Quizzes can import questions from Word files. Learners get accounts created by an admin, a learner dashboard and certificates of completion, and access can be granted or revoked as people join and leave. The Practical NDT section links to the Practical NDT 3D simulator, where trainees can practise technique before they touch a real part. Course completion and training hours then sit alongside the technician's certification record, which helps when you document OJT and classroom hours for the next level.

Procedures and Level III sign-off

The Procedures app keeps a single register of written procedures with document number, revision, method, scope, material, applicable standard such as ASME Section V, acceptance criteria and the text or file. Approved revisions are locked, and every revision is kept as a snapshot.

For a small firm with one Level III, the approval workflow (draft, submitted, reviewed, approved, published, with rejected and archived) creates the paper trail clients ask for without extra admin. Approvers receive email notifications and reminders. The AI-assisted first draft, with a built-in template as fallback, helps when a new client or method needs a procedure quickly; the Level III still reviews and approves it before it is used.

Calibration management software for a compact instrument fleet

Calibration management in the Atlantis ERP tracks each instrument, probe and source-related item by serial number, with calibration frequency, status, next due date and a warning if an out-of-calibration unit is assigned to a job.

Small companies cannot afford to lose a day because the only PAUT unit is at the cal lab or the thickness gauge certificate has lapsed. The Asset Management app records type, assigned person, condition, asset tag, firmware, accessories and lifecycle stage, including rented out, which matters if you rent spare kit to other contractors; rental terms can be recorded against the item. Calibration records hold provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited-lab flag, result and next due date, and the calibration certificate register shows valid, expiring or expired status with alerts. Issue and return run through an approval workflow with condition recorded, reservations prevent clashes, and consumables carry reorder levels and a low-stock flag.

Crew dispatch and NDT reporting for Toledo refinery and plant work

Crew dispatch in the Atlantis ERP moves each job from planned to dispatched, in field, submitted and closed, blocks double-booking of technicians and equipment serials, and shows each technician's utilisation and next available date. Reports cover 17 NDT types with their own numbering and sign-off.

When both Toledo refineries and a manufacturing client want crews the same week, the Team Assignments app shows who is assigned, on leave, in training, sick or unavailable. Assignments carry site GPS coordinates and mobilisation and demobilisation dates, and the Project app carries safety induction and work permit fields.

In the field, technicians use the offline app to write UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ECT, IRIS, PAUT, MFL, TOFD, PWHT, PMI, Hardness, UT thickness, Ferrite, Holiday/coating and Computed Radiography reports, with method-specific data such as RT source, technique and IQI placement, PAUT focal laws and UTT readings by direction. Reports move through draft, in progress, review, approved and sent, with inspector, reviewer and approver signatures and a field for a third-party inspector. Output uses your versioned templates in Excel, Word, PDF or HTML, and client Excel forms fill automatically. See Digital Twin Reporting Software for 3D reporting options.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Toledo contractors

Quoting and invoicing in the Atlantis ERP are tied to the NDT job: a quote becomes a sales order, approved timesheets feed billing, and invoices show labour, equipment and consumables subtotals.

The Quotations app records job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, flags NDT services by method and category, and produces a branded PDF with online acceptance. Timesheets record inspection, travel, standby and setup with a billable flag and overtime multiplier. Invoices carry NDT project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector, with lines by cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician and days or hours. The Expenses app re-bills field expenses and per diems to the job. The open REST API connects to QuickBooks, NetSuite, SAP, Maximo or other API-capable systems, scoped during implementation.

Implementing the Atlantis ERP in Toledo

Implementation is done by Atlantis NDT, remotely and in phases, so a small team can adopt it without stopping work.

  1. Discovery: review your written practice, certificates, instruments, report forms and billing.
  2. Core go-live: certificates, vision tests, exam sheets and instruments loaded, alerts switched on.
  3. Reporting: report templates built and the offline app rolled out to technicians.
  4. Commercial: quotations, invoicing and CRM added, with accounting connections configured during implementation.
  5. Training: eLearning courses and the 3D simulator set up if you train in-house.

What to ask in an NDT ERP demo in Toledo

Many Toledo NDT companies are small, owner-run businesses serving two refineries, a nuclear station and a large automotive base. The owner often quotes, dispatches and invoices personally. The demo should show how much of that load the system takes away.

  • Show a quote turned into a job, then into a crew assignment, then into an invoice, without re-entering the customer or the job details.
  • Show trainee on-the-job hours logged toward Level I and Level II, and the exam record kept with the technician.
  • Show which instruments are due for calibration next month and who currently has them.
  • Show a report pack for a refinery client and a very different one for an automotive supplier.
  • Show the owner dashboard for unbilled work and expiring certificates.

Frequently asked questions

What is the best NDT software for small NDT companies in Toledo?

Software that starts small, links certificates, instruments and reports, and is set up for you. The Atlantis ERP can go live with core apps first and grow, with implementation and support from Atlantis NDT.

Can we track OJT and training hours for technicians we qualify ourselves?

Yes. Each certificate records OJT hours, training hours and exam results, and certificate templates hold minimum hours per scheme.

Does Atlantis offer technician training?

Yes. Atlantis offers ASNT SNT-TC-1A-based NDT training, and the eLearning app and Practical NDT 3D simulator support in-house courses.

Can we record equipment we rent to other contractors?

Yes. Instruments have a rented out lifecycle stage, and rental details can be recorded against the item.

Does it work offline at the refinery?

Yes. The offline field app stores drafts and photos locally and syncs when the device reconnects.

How do we get pricing?

Pricing is quote on request, based on the apps and configuration you choose. Ask for a Toledo quote.
